'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Makiivka military quarters shelling]]
***Hundreds of Russian [[2022 Russian mobilization|mobilized]] soldiers are claimed by Ukraine to be killed and injured as a result of an [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian]] missile attack on a [[vocational school]] building serving as military barracks. Russian authorities acknowledge several casualties, but suggest lower figures. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-shells-donetsks-makiivka-hitting-military-quarters-officials-2023-01-01/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64142650 (BBC News)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[Colombian government]] reaches a bilateral [[ceasefire]] agreement with the major armed groups involved in the conflict, including the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]], [[FARC dissidents]], and the [[Clan del Golfo]]. The ceasefire will be in effect from January 1 to at least June 30. [https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/colombia-agrees-on-ceasefire-with-eln-guerrillas-farc-dissidents-and-drug-gangs-president-1.1672558767605 (AFP via ''Gulf News'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eight people are killed and nine others are injured by a [[landslide]] in [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/landslide-kills-least-8-people-eastern-congo-2022-12-31/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Lebanese Navy]] and [[United Nations]] forces rescue a [[capsizing]] boat of 232 migrants in the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. Two people perish in the overnight [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|incident]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/lebanese-troops-rescue-migrants-vessel-2-killed-96018708 (ABC News)]
*Fifteen people are killed and 47 others are injured after a bus crashed and flipped in [[Nayarit]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-automotive-accidents-caribbean-ff23c4c428dcb94c3a959de1bb4b436c (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Death and funeral of Pope Benedict XVI]]
**[[Pope]] [[Bishops in the Catholic Church#Pope emeritus|emeritus]] [[Pope Benedict XVI|Benedict XVI]], who served from 2005 until [[Resignation of Pope Benedict XVI|his resignation]] in 2013, dies at the age of 95, with the funeral scheduled for January 5. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64107731 (BBC News)]
